speaker: Doctor
text: The blood gas and culture results are normal. Since the infant has no prenatal care, do you know if the mother had a prolonged rupture of membranes or if she had any signs of infection during labor?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely Patent Ductus Arteriosus), bluish non-blanching macules (blueberry muffin rash), and cloudy lenses (cataracts) is pathognomonic for this condition, even with normal blood gases. Have you noticed any failure to thrive or hearing loss in addition to the failed auditory screening?
